'''Wardport Landa''' was an outpost owned by [[House Alde]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and affiliated to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Wardport Landa was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alethios]], while [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cahill]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Raikon]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Corlis Brado Cressen]] were stationed there as well.
